title: Performance+
description: Originally just gonna be an installation for me to play the latest 26.2 release. Preformance tweaks for a smoother experience and to stop your PC from exploding. Quality for life like custom model and animation support.
body:
I want to make an OOBE (Out of the Box Experience) for the Chaos Cubed game drop. 
Not just performance, includes quality of life and shader support. 



Performance tweaks for garbage computers. 

Custom Models and Animations for entities.

Shader support using Iris

Credits to CaffeineMC (the creator of Sodium), for the icon inspiration.


NOT COMPATIBLE WITH THE VULKAN RENDERING API AS IRIS SHADERS IS IN THIS MODPACK AND DOES NOT SUPPORT VULKAN YET. Will be updated when Iris adds Vulkan support. Grab the Vulkan enabled version Performance+, Download Performance+ for Vulkan at: https://modrinth.com/project/bHqCzV7L
    Edit: As the setting cannot be pre-applied at first launch, we will have to either wait for a fix or you will have to manually disable Sulkan, the shader engine, launch and apply Vulkan,  close Minecraft and enable Sulkan, then you are ready to go.
